title: Kamailio World Conference Online 2022 – Starting Tomorrow
html:
Time has come for another online edition of Kamailio World Conference, the event enabling community networking and knowledge sharing for Kamailio SIP Server project.

The 10th edition starts tomorrow, Wednesday, September 7, 2022, at 12:50UTC.

It is free to attend, no registration is required, just follow the links for live streams and chat channels posted on the event website at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k10-online/

The sessions cover topics from NAT traversal and controlling RTPEngine, to 5G/VoLTE with Kamailio, scalability best practices and building VoIP clusters, testing, TLS and secure communication, dialog extensions and KEMI SIP message operations.

Two open discussion panels allow direct interaction between Kamailio developers and the broad community of users or just people interested to hear what Kamailio can do. The event finishes with the celebration party session to mark 21 years of  Kamailio development, 20 years of open source Kamailio and 10 editions of Kamailio World Conference!

Looking forward to seeing you online during the next days!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
